instruction: Examine hard-10_seed.dxf. For this task, launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-10_seed.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'open sprocket guard with mounting foot' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (15,70)->(0,35); OUTLINE (0,35)->(52,35); OUTLINE (185,70)->(220,35); OUTLINE (220,35)->(148,35); OUTLINE (50,0)->(150,0); OUTLINE (150,0)->(150,35); OUTLINE (150,35)->(50,35); OUTLINE (50,35)->(50,0); CUTOUT (30,105)->(70,105); CUTOUT (30,95)->(70,95); CUTOUT (130,105)->(170,105); CUTOUT (130,95)->(170,95); CENTER (100,10)->(100,190); CENTER (10,100)->(190,100). Required circles: HOLE center (172.28,123.485) radius 4; HOLE center (144.672,161.485) radius 4; HOLE center (100,176) radius 4; HOLE center (55.328,161.485) radius 4; HOLE center (27.72,123.485) radius 4; HOLE center (27.72,76.515) radius 4; HOLE center (55.328,38.515) radius 4; HOLE center (100,24) radius 4; HOLE center (144.672,38.515) radius 4; HOLE center (172.28,76.515) radius 4; HOLE center (65,17.5) radius 5; HOLE center (100,17.5) radius 5; HOLE center (135,17.5) radius 5. Required arcs: OUTLINE center (100,100) radius 90 start 20 end 340; CUTOUT center (100,100) radius 62 start 25 end 335; CUTOUT center (30,100) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (70,100) radius 5 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (130,100) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (170,100) radius 5 start 270 end 90. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H10; ANNOTATION text SPROCKET GUARD. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
